fib: ______ is a statistical property of two or more time series that suggests a long-term relationship among them.
Cointegration
Cointegration is a statistical property of two or more time series that suggests a long-term relationship among them.
______ is the application of statistical methods to economic data and is described as the branch of economics that aims to give empirical content to economic relations.
Econometrics
Econometrics is the application of statistical methods to economic data and is described as the branch of economics that aims to give empirical content to economic relations.
______ is a tool that provides correlation coefficients of a time series with its own lagged values.
autocorrelation function (ACF)
autocorrelation function
ACF
The autocorrelation function (ACF) is a tool that provides correlation coefficients of a time series with its own lagged values.
______ is a common statistical procedure used to decide between the FE and RE models.
Hausman test
The Hausman test is a common statistical procedure used to decide between the FE and RE models.
______ are used when a value from a time series is regressed on previous values from the same time series.
Autoregressive models
Autoregressive models are used when a value from a time series is regressed on previous values from the same time series.
______ is a desirable property for many statistical models because they assume the underlying data's properties remain constant over time.
Stationarity
Stationarity is a desirable property for many statistical models because they assume the underlying data's properties remain constant over time.
______ are used to predict or estimate the value of the dependent variables.
Mathematical functions
Mathematical functions are used to predict or estimate the value of the dependent variables.
______ is considered by many to be one of the founding fathers of econometrics.
Jan Tinbergen
Jan Tinbergen is considered by many to be one of the founding fathers of econometrics.
______ is used to determine the level of significance of each regressor in the model.
Value (Pv)
Value
Value (Pv) is used to determine the level of significance of each regressor in the model.
______ is a powerful tool used extensively in econometrics.
Regression analysis
Regression Regression analysis is a powerful tool used extensively in econometrics.
______ is a means of reconciliating the short-run behaviour of an economic variable to its long-run behaviour.
Error Correction Mechanism
The Error Correction Mechanism is a means of reconciliating the short-run behaviour of an economic variable to its long-run behaviour.
______ is a vital component of econometric analysis.
measurement of trends
The measurement of trends is a vital component of econometric analysis.
______ is a type of dynamic regression model, capturing relationships between variables across time.
ARDL model
The ARDL model is a type of dynamic regression model, capturing relationships between variables across time.
